stories.title: Prove secret-class rows serve schema-only on /proposals and /changes
stories.scope: Live acceptance harness `node platform/scripts/demo-verify.mjs` (read-only; green 25/25 as of 2026-10-06). Fixture: agent-5 carries exactly one secret-class file `config/.env` with fake placeholder values; `node platform/scripts/secret-fixture.mjs` restores it idempotently (agent-5 only, nothing lands). Asserts schema-only rendering plus a no-egress sweep over every fetched body. Seams: platform/src/index.ts:229-245 (isSecretPath/secretKeys), :435 (intent dropped on secret rows), :461-466 + :488-489 (keys only; patch never exists), :613-625 (proposal surface); CONTRACT.md §Secret classes (:173-179).
stories.acceptance: `node platform/scripts/demo-verify.mjs` exits 0 with PASS 25/25: agent-5 `/proposals` row has `secret:true` and `keys` exactly ["DATABASE_URL","REDIS_URL"]; the agent-5 proposal carries no `intent`; the `/changes?repo=agent-5` row for `config/.env` has no `patch` key; and no leak marker (`FAKE-SECRET-DO-NOT-USE`, `postgres://demo`, `db.internal`, `cache.internal`) appears in any fetched raw body (/proposals, /changes, /judge).
stories.notes: Delta only vs store rows `secret-class-widening-scrub` [pending] (widening + body-side free-text scrub) and `schema-only-decoupled-views-for-secret-files-demo-beat` [pending]; no rebuild — the live proof. Overlap noted for `scan-intent-and-notes-text-for-secrets-and-pii-leaks` [pending] (semantic-leak judge), out of scope here. Precondition: agent-5 fixture present (secret-fixture.mjs is the idempotent restorer).

stories.title: Prove secret-class values never enter judge state, logs, or free-text scrub output
stories.scope: Offline contract suite `bun porting/tests/judge.test.mjs` — worker.fetch exercised through an in-memory Artifacts fake and a scripted AI binding (no platform source changes). Protects: case 3 (secret-class repo skipped pre-model by name, reason `secret-class`, no path/value in the payload), case 11 (outbound judge state: no fixture secret value, no `API_TOKEN=`, plain `KEY=VALUE` -> `[redacted]`, instruction lines stripped, `[UNTRUSTED-REPO-DATA]` delimiters, secret row = `{path,status,secret,keys}` only), case 15 (content-free logs `{setId,model,judged,skipped}`). Seams: platform/src/judge.ts:55-89 (stripInstructionLike/scrubFreeText), :196-211 (maskJudgeFile), platform/src/index.ts:1058-1066 (pre-model skip).
stories.acceptance: `bun porting/tests/judge.test.mjs` exits 0 (ALL PASS), including: case 3 — agent-4 skipped `{repo,reason:"secret-class"}` and the payload string contains neither `config` nor `.env` nor the fixture secret value; case 11 — outbound state JSON contains no fixture secret value and no `API_TOKEN=`, contains `SESSION_SECRET=[redacted]`, and the fabricated secret row serializes to exactly `{path,status,secret,keys}`; case 15 — captured console output contains no secret value and no repo text, and the single `judge ` log line parses to exactly `{setId,model,judged,skipped}`.
stories.notes: Proves the built judge-channel masking + free-text scrub (FR-28 consequences 2-3 as built). The body-channel scrub of intent/notes/errors is NOT built and lives in `secret-class-widening-scrub` [pending] — deliberately not verified here. Overlap: `scan-intent-and-notes-text-for-secrets-and-pii-leaks` [pending].

stories.title: Prove merge previews render withheld-secret rows with no text
stories.scope: Live read-only `GET /merge?base=demo&repos=agent-5` (wire shape CONTRACT.md §/merge: file rows `{path,action,result,merged?,conflictText?,note?}` with `result` one of merged|conflict|withheld-secret). UI branch: platform/ui/app.js:805-809 renders `result === "withheld-secret"` as the 'Secret content withheld' empty state with no patch. Precondition: agent-5 secret fixture present (`node platform/scripts/secret-fixture.mjs` restores it idempotently).
stories.acceptance: Command exits 0: /merge returns exactly one `config/.env` row with `result == "withheld-secret"`, a `note` containing `withheld`, and neither `merged` nor `conflictText`; the withheld UI branch exists (app.js:805-809) so the preview renders the notice and no text.
stories.check_cmd: curl -sS "https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/merge?base=demo&repos=agent-5" | jq -ec '[.merge.files[] | select(.path=="config/.env")] | length==1 and .[0].result=="withheld-secret" and (.[0]|has("merged")|not) and (.[0]|has("conflictText")|not) and ((.[0].note // "")|test("withheld"))' && grep -q "Secret content withheld" platform/ui/app.js
stories.notes: Verified live by the author on 2026-10-06 (exit 0). Overlap: `complete-unified-proposal-card-intent-diff-risk-provenance` [pending] covers card facets — delta only; this story proves the withheld merge-preview law (FR-29 consequence 2).

stories.title: Prove /land refuses secret-class folds with 409 withheld-secret and pushes nothing
stories.scope: Author the live scratch probe `porting/tests/withheld-land.probe.mjs` (pattern: porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs — Artifacts REST via wrangler OAuth, scratch-only names, cleanup in finally, never touches demo or agent-1..5). Chain: fork demo -> `demo-wh-base`; fork demo -> `agent-wh-1`; commit `config/.env` (fake placeholder lines) with an intent note; push main + refs/notes/commits + `refs/notes/commits:refs/heads/nextgit-notes` (CONTRACT recipe). Then `POST /land {base:"demo-wh-base",repos:["agent-wh-1"]}` -> assert 409 `{ok:false,error:"withheld-secret",files:["config/.env"]}`; assert the scratch base head sha is unchanged after the refusal (values never pushed); assert GET /merge on the same chain is withheld with no text; delete both scratch repos on exit. Proof instrument only — no platform/src changes. Seams: platform/src/index.ts:862-871 (withheld gate before mint/push), :326-333 + :365-372 (fold withholds), CONTRACT.md §Secret classes and the /land precondition order (:104).
stories.acceptance: `node porting/tests/withheld-land.probe.mjs` exits 0: /land responds 409 with `error == "withheld-secret"` and `files == ["config/.env"]`; the scratch base ref sha equals its pre-land value (nothing was pushed); the merge preview row for the same fold is `withheld-secret` with no `merged`/`conflictText`; both scratch repos are deleted even on failure.
stories.notes: No existing automated check exercised the refused-land path (demo-verify is read-only; land-hardening.probe.mjs covers AD-3 only) — hence the probe. Overlaps `secret-class-widening-scrub` [pending] and `trust-beat-content-based-secret-detection` [pending] (widening/detection), not recreated. `platform/scripts/land.mjs:58-68` prints this refusal path to operators.

stories.title: Prove the path-driven masking posture and its documented v1 limit
stories.scope: Author `porting/tests/masking-posture.test.mjs` (worker.fetch + in-memory Artifacts fake patterned on judge.test.mjs; no source edits). Cases: (a) table over every documented class — `.env`, `.env.local`, `*.pem` (`certs/server.pem`), `*.key` (`tls/server.key`), `cert.p12`, `credentials.json`, `secrets.json`, `.dev.vars`, any `secrets/` path (`config/secrets/api.txt`) — each /changes row is `secret:true` with `keys[]` and no `patch`; (b) a `KEY=VALUE` payload at a non-class path (`src/config.ts`) is served with its patch unredacted — the documented v1 limitation (values must live in secret-class paths); (c) CONTRACT.md documents the class list and the additive-widening rule (new class ships as a contract bump; the class list is one seam consumed by every read path). Seams: platform/src/index.ts:226-245 (single class list), :461-466 (row masking), :488-489 (patch never exists for secret rows), CONTRACT.md:173-179.
stories.acceptance: `bun porting/tests/masking-posture.test.mjs` exits 0: every documented class masks to `secret:true` + `keys[]` with no `patch`; the non-class `KEY=VALUE` file's patch is served unredacted (the limitation is proven, not assumed); the suite asserts CONTRACT.md carries the classes and the additive widening rule. Content-based detection is out of scope — sequenced M2.
stories.notes: M2 follows FR-30's milestone hint (content detection sequenced M2; implementation home: E6-impl + store row `trust-beat-content-based-secret-detection` [pending]); the path-driven half is live today and this verification is runnable now. Widening + body-side free-text scrub implementation: `secret-class-widening-scrub` [pending] — not recreated.

stories.title: Prove intent readers resolve from the nextgit-notes mirror, with the fallback carrier
stories.scope: Author `porting/tests/notes-mirror.test.mjs` (worker.fetch + in-memory Artifacts fake; no source edits). Cases: (a) a note blob on the `nextgit-notes` branch keyed by the head sha resolves for /changes file rows and the /proposals card; (b) fan-out note trees (`ab/<sha>`) resolve by path suffix; (c) when no note matches, `NEXTGIT_INTENT/<sha>.txt` (then `NEXTGIT_INTENT/intent.txt`) serves; (d) the note wins over the fallback when both exist; (e) intent is capped at 500 chars. Seams: platform/src/index.ts:167-220 (NOTES_BRANCH `nextgit-notes`, INTENT_FILE `NEXTGIT_INTENT`, readNotes/readIntent/readIntentFile/capIntent), :435 (file-row intent), :613 (card intent).
stories.acceptance: `bun porting/tests/notes-mirror.test.mjs` exits 0 with (a)-(e) green: served intent text equals the mirror note text (capped at 500 chars); the fan-out path resolves; the fallback carrier serves only when the note is absent; a repo with neither serves no `intent`.
stories.notes: Delta vs judge.test.mjs, whose fake returns [] for the mirror branch and therefore only covers the NEXTGIT_INTENT fallback — the mirror read path is untested offline. Overlaps `attach-mandatory-per-write-provenance-via-git-notes` [pending] (per-write attribution fields) and `per-worker-traces-git-notes-records-h4-provenance-gap` [pending] — not recreated.

stories.title: Prove the single three-refspec intent push and durability across branch movement
stories.scope: Author the live scratch probe `porting/tests/intent-notes.probe.mjs` (pattern: land-hardening.probe.mjs; scratch-only `agent-in-1`; cleanup in finally). Fork demo -> agent-in-1; attach a git note to the head commit + write `NEXTGIT_INTENT/<sha>.txt`; perform the runner's single push with the CONTRACT recipe (`git push origin main refs/notes/commits refs/notes/commits:refs/heads/nextgit-notes`, platform/CONTRACT.md:163-171; runner sites platform/scripts/agents.mjs:266-272 and real-agents.mjs:408-411). Assert: the `nextgit-notes` mirror exists; `/changes?repo=agent-in-1&ref=<shaA>` serves the note intent; after the branch advances to sha B (rebase analog: the branch moves, the notes ref is untouched) the note for shaA still resolves and the fallback carrier serves B; a divergent non-fast-forward write to the mirror is rejected (FF-only); `/proposals?base=demo&repos=agent-in-1` carries the intent (card). No platform/src changes.
stories.acceptance: `node porting/tests/intent-notes.probe.mjs` exits 0: one three-refspec push leaves the mirror branch; intent resolves for the original commit after the branch advances; the fallback carrier serves the new head; a divergent mirror write is rejected as non-fast-forward; the proposal card carries the intent string; the scratch repo is deleted on exit.
stories.notes: Complements `e6-verify-notes-mirror-readers` (offline reader precedence) with the live push recipe, durability, and FF-only mirror behavior. Overlaps `attach-mandatory-per-write-provenance-via-git-notes` [pending] (per-write attribution) — not recreated. Single-pusher rule (runner pushes, agents never push refs) is process evidence: the only push site carrying the notes refspec is the runner scripts.

No writes.
stories.acceptance: Command exits 0: `/proposals` returns `ok:true`, `base.repo == "demo"`, `ref == "main"`; the header elements `base-val`/`ref-val` exist in index.html and app.js binds them (`baseVal`/`refVal`) from the payload — the header shows the live baseline, not a hardcoded label.
